prompt_en: Create a documentary photograph of an adult fictional woman whose general appearance follows the attached portrait: long center-parted dark wavy hair, brown eyes, a softly oval facial outline, natural brows, and attentive calm. In a quiet nocturnal conservation salon above a storm-flooded city, she is the sole private materials advisor to one adult client holding a water-damaged heirloom map case. One advisor responds to one client's stated need: she responds directly to the damaged edge by presenting exactly three relevant leather-and-lining options, a limited curated selection on a compact viewing tray. Careful gloved handling at the object: her hands fit the selected protective insert around the same rolled map and perform a live fit or function check, testing the closure as the client points to the water mark. A blank repair restoration or aftercare record lies open beside the selected swatch, linking the same case to a follow-up care plan. One intimate medium-wide frame keeps both adults, the tray, active hands, and damage readable; warm task light falls across leather, paper, and wood while cool storm reflections stay secondary.
negative_en: low resolution, illustration look, cartoon style, excessive HDR, body distortion, over-processed retouching, unrealistic hands, distorted fingers
